column1: # The differences between free5GC's NGAP library and the crate that were triaged (compare.py).
# Columns, separated by tabs: what (the kind of difference, `*` for any: crate-refuses,
# free5gc-refuses, message, value, ie), where (a regular expression over the text of the
# difference), verdict (free5gc: free5GC reads the octets otherwise than the clause;
# crate-by-clause: the crate does what the clause says; both: both read them as the clause
# allows; gap: free5GC does not implement the IE or the message; open: the cause is not
# traced), and the reference: the clause of TS 38.413 V19.4.0, and why.

column2: ^\w+ IE \d+: only the crate has it$
column4: §10.3.4.2: free5GC v1.2.0 has no field of the IE in the message, an IE of a later release or one that its message lacks, and ignores it as an IE not comprehended of criticality ignore
§10.3.4.1: free5GC v1.2.0 has no procedure of the code, of a later release or of none, and refuses the PDU as a procedure code not comprehended
§10.3.4.2: an IE that free5GC v1.2.0 does not have, of criticality reject, for which the receiver rejects the procedure

§10.3.4.2: an extension of an IE that free5GC v1.2.0 does not have: it refuses the PDU whatever the criticality of the extension (ie/protocol_extension_field.go reads the criticality and does not use it), where the receiver ignores an extension of criticality ignore

§9.3.1.8, TS 36.413 §9.2.1.37: free5GC v1.2.0 decodes each BIT STRING alternative of an NgENB-ID as the long macro one, and of an ENB-ID as its long macro one (ie/ng_enbid.go, ie/enbid.go), and reads the bits after it from the wrong place; Wireshark 4.6.4 and pycrate read the vector as the crate does
§9.3.1.8: free5GC v1.2.0 decodes a macro or a short macro NgENB-ID as a long macro one, of 21 bits, and writes it back so (ie/ng_enbid.go)

§10.3.4.2: free5GC v1.2.0 reads an extension of the IE that it has, and writes it back with a value of one octet, without the octets of the value that it read; in a SON Configuration Transfer also after an NgENB-ID that it decodes as a long macro one (row above)
free5GC v1.2.0 reads the IE and its Write refuses the value that it read
X.691 §11.9.3.8: a list or a bit string of 16384 entries or more, whose length is fragmented; free5GC v1.2.0 has no fragmentation
§10.3.5, §10.3.6: a mandatory IE that the message lacks, or an IE repeated; free5GC refuses the PDU, the crate reads it and check() tells it
§10.3.6, §9.2.3.2: the NAS Security Parameters from NG-RAN erroneously present for the Handover Type; free5GC refuses the PDU, the crate reads it
